subject: Contingency retainer and escalation credit framework — pricing & next steps
messages:
From: Kendra Liu <kendra@brightbox.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T13:12:00Z
Subject: Quick: contingency retainer + escalation coverage for pilot

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising. Before we commit the pilot, procurement has two asks that will impact our procurement cadence:

- Can you outline a contingency retainer option (monthly) that guarantees prioritized escalation routing and a named on-call response? We need to understand the price mechanics (flat retainer, consumption offset, credits).
- If uptime dips below the agreed tier during the pilot, what form of credits do you offer and how are they calculated? We need a clear table we can share with legal.

High-level context: this is a 3-month pilot targeting 3 regional clusters, initial commit ~200k tokens/month, possible expansion if pilot metrics look good. Procurement will want a sample term sheet and an SLA credit table.

Can you send something by EOD Monday PT? Procurement copied: procurement@brightbox.com.

Best,
Kendra
Director of Platform Partnerships
BrightBox
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Kendra Liu <kendra@brightbox.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: contingency retainer + escalation coverage for pilot

Kendra — thanks for the early heads-up. Really excited to partner on the pilot.

Short answer: yes. Attached is a draft pricing worksheet that shows two packaged approaches and an SLA credit matrix. High-level options:

Option A — Contingency Retainer (flat monthly):
- Flat fee: $8,000/month for prioritized escalation routing, a named on-call engineer during pilot hours (8am–8pm PT), and a 2-hour initial triage SLA.
- Consumption offset: up to $3,000/month of the retainer can be applied to usage if you convert to a 12-month committed contract.

Option B — Usage + Rapid Response Add-on:
- No flat retainer; rapid response add-on charged at $150/hour (billed in 15-min increments) with a 24/7 escalation rota.
- Credit mechanism: if monthly uptime < 99.5% we apply automated token-credit calculations per the attached matrix.

I've put the detailed numbers and an illustrative credit table in pricing_worksheet_v2.xlsx (attached). Ben is cc'd because we can flex structure if this lands in procurement's lane.

If either approach is promising, I can loop in Lauren to draft a short term sheet for procurement.

Best,
Avery
Senior GTM — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_worksheet_v2.xlsx (Excel workbook, 4 sheets — summary, credit-table, regional-ops, notes)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Kendra Liu <kendra@brightbox.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T01:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: contingency retainer + escalation coverage for pilot

Looping in a short pricing tweak that might help procurement move faster. If BrightBox is willing to do a 6-month pilot commit (pay-as-you-go but committed minimum usage), we can do:

- Retainer reduction: $6,000/month (instead of $8,000) with a guaranteed 4-hour on-call response window and named escalation lead during business hours.
- Volume credit: if monthly usage exceeds 250k tokens, automatically apply a 10% usage credit the following month.
- SLA uplift: for guaranteed 99.8% uptime we provide an additional one-time onboarding credit equivalent to one month of retainer (applied to first invoice).

Reasonable trade: lower upfront for procurement, but we still protect engineers with a modest retainer. Attached is a short calc I used to model impact on TCV.

On the credit table: I suggest we be explicit about credit caps (no more than 50% of monthly bill can be credited in any month) and a 30-day cure period for operational investigations. Happy to have Lauren bake into terms.

-Ben
Director, Solutions Pricing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal_calc_short.pdf (one-pager)
From: Kendra Liu <kendra@brightbox.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightbox.com
Date: 2026-06-16T20:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: contingency retainer + escalation coverage for pilot

Thanks — this is very helpful. Procurement is inclined toward Option A shape but with the 6-month reduced retainer Ben proposed. Two asks from our side before we can move to legal: 

1) Can you provide a one-page SLA credit table that maps specific uptime bands to exact credit percentages and an example calculation using our expected $12k/mo usage for the pilot? Legal likes deterministic math.
2) We need a short term sheet that limits credit exposure (the 50% cap Ben mentioned) and clarifies the dispute/cure process (how long we investigate, credit timing). Also specify who the named escalation lead is for the pilot.

Procurement is also asking for a DocuSign-ready term sheet so we can circulate internally. If you can send the one-pager and a DocuSign link by EOD Thursday PT, that would keep our timeline intact.

On timing: pilot start target is July 6th.

Best,
Kendra
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kendra Liu <kendra@brightbox.com>, procurement@brightbox.com
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: contingency retainer + escalation coverage for pilot — term sheet + credit table

Kendra / BrightBox procurement — hello. Per Avery and Ben's pricing threads, attached are:

1) contingency_retainer_term_sheet.pdf — one-page term sheet (6-month pilot, $6,000/month retainer, up to $3,000 consumption offset if converted to annual commit). Named escalation lead: Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwood.com) during business hours; escalation rota provided for 24/7 after go-live.

2) sla-credit-matrix.csv — deterministic table mapping uptime bands to credit percentages and a sample calculation for a $12,000 monthly bill:
   - >=99.9%: no credit
   - 99.5%–99.9%: 10% credit
   - 99.0%–99.5%: 25% credit
   - <99.0%: 50% credit (capped at 50% of monthly invoice)

3) pricing_worksheet_v2.xlsx (re-attached) — summary tab includes the volume credit clauses and the onboarding credit for 99.8% SLA.

Process notes:
- Investigation window: Redwood will initiate a post-incident review within 48 hours and provide a root-cause update within 10 business days. Credits, if applicable, will be applied on the next invoice following the conclusion of the review.
- Disputes: either party may escalate to a joint technical review; credits are applied provisionally in cases where Redwood's monitoring corroborates the outage, pending final RCA.

Next steps: if this aligns, please confirm acceptance of the term sheet and we'll send a DocuSign packet for signature (standard 48-hour internal turnaround recommended). If procurement needs a different named escalation lead, tell us and we'll update the sheet.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Head of Contracts & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: contingency_retainer_term_sheet.pdf; sla-credit-matrix.csv; pricing_worksheet_v2.xlsx
